text: Following Zarth, you arrive at Olobaid Castle. What he's\nafter seems to be here. Unbeknownst to you, Olant and\nPotumkin have tagged along. Explore the castle with them!
There is another door on 2F that leads to the next floor.\nLooks like you need to solve the riddle on this floor to\nproceed. Let's split up and search for clues!
There are some strange statues on 3F.\nThis area appears to have upper and lower floors.\nCheck the surroundings to proceed!
On the top floor, you find the "Snow Mist Jewel" that Zarth\nhas been searching for. However, the master of the castle\nstands in your way. Defeat Olobaid to obtain the jewel!
